name: F.E. Walter Dam
public_profile: Location: Bear Creek Township, Luzerne County and Kidder Township, Carbon County, Pennsylvania
Purpose: flood control, water storage, recreation
Opened: 1961; operated by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
Type: earth-fill embankment with rock shell, impounding the Lehigh River
operation_target_description: Your goal is to keep the water level within the designated seasonal pool levels. From November 1 through March 14, keep the pool near the conservation pool at 1300.0 ft N.G.V.D., within 1297.0 to 1303.0 ft. From March 15 through May 9, keep the pool between 1300.0 and 1370.0 ft and, when hydrologic conditions allow, fill toward 1370.0 ft by May 10. From May 10 through October 14, keep the pool at or below 1370.0 ft. From October 15 through October 31, keep the pool between 1300.0 and 1370.0 ft and lower it toward 1300.0 ft by November 1.
